descriptions.text: Krakaren Clone! Level 10 Neighborhood Boss! First off, this isn't the Krakaren. This is a Krakaren. For every one that is killed, Krakaren Prime births two more. Part of a collective mind intent upon destroying any semblance of scientific progress in the universe, the Krakaren is the only communal brain entity in the galaxy who actually gets stupider as time moves on. Consisting of multiple, shrieking tentacles, members of the Krakaren cooperative spend their days birthing their disease-laden minions, creating and selling harmful products, attempting to debate scientific experts, and proselytizing to the weak-minded, all in an attempt to… Well, nobody knows what the hell their end goal is.

recap.text: The Krakaren is a twenty-foot immobile octopus in a chamber with cut wooden letters spelling Live, Laugh, Love over the door. She sits behind a still producing industrial volumes of toilet-grade moonshine and has tentacles lined with screaming human mouths that drip something that stops healing. The barefoot man and the cat drink a blended corpse to take her apart. She is a copy of an original committee.

Elle reports that her team left a borough boss named Krakaren alone. Stage three of the DTs turns creatures into hippo-sized mouths with tentacles. Carl kills one on the Vermillion line, and it hatches thousands of level one Krakaren Crotch Dumplings the size of rice. Carl stomps some and burns others with moonshine. Thousands of growing Krakaren pour out of holes in every station.

Krakaren Prime brewed the Hell-Kissed Potion of Conscription in the dark recesses of the Nothing. Banished for yearning for domination, she prepares for an inevitable war. The in-dungeon version of Krakaren supplied these potions to the War Mages.

The Krakaren is one of the six powers fighting over the place, sitting with the sapient mobs. Krakaren Prime, level 235, is the boss of the floor and the source of every clone sold as a boss fight. She sits atop a tree in the arena until Scolopendra coils around the wood, cracking it like a twig and raining down a green mist.

beats.headline: The thing behind the moonshine
beats.text: Twenty feet of immobile octopus in a chamber with Live, Laugh, Love spelled out over the door in cut wooden letters, sitting behind a still that produces toilet-grade moonshine at industrial volume. Her tentacles are lined with human mouths that scream without pause and drip something that stops a body healing. The cat and the barefoot man take her apart and drink a blended corpse to do it. She is not the point. She is a copy, and somewhere there is an original, and the original is a committee.
beats.gist: A barefoot man and a cat drink a blended corpse to dismantle the Krakaren.

beats.headline: One at every fifth station
beats.text: Elle passes the word along: at one of the every-fifth stations her team fought three neighbourhood bosses and left the borough boss alone. A miss Krakaren, Imani calls her, an old friend. A borough boss is a size up from the one in the distillery, and there is no reason to think she is the only one. The dungeon does not run short of them, because running short is not a thing this creature can do. Take one apart and the original makes two.
beats.gist: Elle's team left the borough boss, Imani, a Krakaren hive mind that doubles when taken apart.

beats.headline: The stage three hatches
beats.text: Stage three of the DTs turns anything, ogre or rat, into the same hippo-sized mouth with tentacles on its back, and it is always fatal. The one Carl's party brings down on the Vermillion line gives no experience, because it has not died. It has hatched. Several thousand Krakaren Crotch Dumplings, level one, each the size of a grain of rice and already growing. A crawler named Donita Grace messages from stop 24 that there are millions of them there. The dungeon tells a bedtime story about a lonely creature who could not have children and made clones instead, and recommends a firm stomp. Carl stomps, then burns the rest with moonshine.
beats.gist: Stage three DTs turn creatures into hippo-sized mouths with tentacles; Carl stomps and burns Krakaren Crotch Dumplings.

beats.headline: The stairwell stations flood
beats.text: One day left on the floor clock and they come out of the deep tunnels in numbers nobody in production budgeted for. Thousands of them, growing as they travel, pouring up out of holes in the middle of every station, hours before a single stairwell opens. Carl warned everybody this was coming, in detail, on an open channel. Being right about it helps nobody at all.
beats.gist: Thousands of Krakaren pour out of deep tunnels into every station before any stairwell opens.

beats.headline: Brewed in the Nothing
beats.text: File note on the Hell-Kissed Potion of Conscription, level 18, of which Crawler Carl now holds a duplicated copy: it will work against pretty much any unaffiliated entity, most deities included. Most. It was brewed in the dark recesses of the Nothing by Krakaren Prime, who is said to yearn for domination and was banished there for it, and who prepares for a war she considers inevitable. The in-dungeon version of Krakaren supplied these potions to the War Mages. The irony is noted.
beats.gist: Krakaren Prime brewed the Hell-Kissed Potion of Conscription in the Nothing and supplied it to War Mages.

beats.headline: Filed among the six powers
beats.text: For once I am straight with the room and I list the six groups still fighting over this place: crawlers, standard NPCs, gods, sapient mobs, the demons of Sheol, and one more I decline to name. The Krakaren sits in the fourth group, next to the shadow mimics and the war mages. That is a considerable promotion from neighbourhood boss and an unpleasant thing to learn at this hour.
beats.gist: The Krakaren is a sapient mob filed among the six powers fighting over the place.

beats.headline: Krakaren Prime, in the arena
beats.text: The procession reaches the arena and the original is up the tree in the middle of it, roaring, too high to be seen from the door. Krakaren Prime, the committee itself, in a ring where the monsters and the stand-ins are already tearing into each other before anyone gives a signal. Every clone in every distillery and every station on every floor was birthed by this, two for every one killed, and sold to an audience as a boss fight.
beats.gist: The procession reaches the arena where Krakaren Prime roars from a tree.

beats.headline: Level 235, and not only angry at them
beats.text: For the record: Krakaren Prime, level 235, is this floor's boss, sitting atop the tree in the middle of the arena and very pissed off, and not only at the crawlers. I was not going to bring her. I caught wind of what Carl and someone else are planning, and it seemed appropriate. When Scolopendra coils around the tree the wood cracks like a twig, and a green mist rains down from the top.
beats.gist: Krakaren Prime is a level 235 boss sitting atop a tree in the arena.
